GRADE 10 CORE MATHEMATICS
 MID TERM 2 EXAM 2026
 MARKING SCHEME
SECTION A: 40 MARKS
Question 1: Simplify: (2x²y)(3xy³)
[4 marks marks]
 (2x²y)(3xy³)
 = 2 × 3 × x² × x × y × y³
 = 6 × x⁽²⁺¹⁾ × y⁽¹⁺³⁾
 = 6x³y⁴
 ✓ Final answer: 6x³y⁴ (4 marks)
Question 2: Solve: 3(2x − 5) = 4x + 7
[4 marks marks]
 3(2x − 5) = 4x + 7
 6x − 15 = 4x + 7 [1 mark - expanding]
 6x − 4x = 7 + 15 [1 mark - collecting like terms]
 2x = 22 [1 mark - simplifying]
 x = 11 [1 mark - solution]
 ✓ Check: 3(2(11) − 5) = 3(22 − 5) = 3(17) = 51; 4(11) + 7 = 44 + 7 = 51 ✓
Question 3: A number increased by 20% to give 96. Find the original number.
[4 marks marks]
 Let the original number = x [1 mark - set up variable]
 20% of x = 0.2x
 x + 0.2x = 96 [1 mark - setting up equation]
 1.2x = 96 [1 mark - simplifying]
 x = 96 ÷ 1.2
 x = 80 [1 mark - solution]
 ✓ Check: 80 + 20% of 80 = 80 + 16 = 96 ✓
Question 4: Evaluate: 2³ × 2⁵ ÷ 2⁴
[4 marks marks]
 Using law of indices: aᵐ × aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ and aᵐ ÷ aⁿ = aᵐ⁻ⁿ
 2³ × 2⁵ ÷ 2⁴
 = 2⁽³⁺⁵⁻⁴⁾ [2 marks - applying law of indices]
 = 2⁴ [1 mark - simplifying exponent]
 = 16 [1 mark - final answer]
Question 5: Factorize completely: x² − 9x + 20
[4 marks marks]
 We need two numbers that:
 • Multiply to give 20
 • Add to give −9
 Those numbers are −4 and −5 [1 mark - identifying factors]
 x² − 9x + 20 = (x − 4)(x − 5) [2 marks - factorisation]
 ✓ Check: (x − 4)(x − 5) = x² − 5x − 4x + 20 = x² − 9x + 20 ✓ [1 mark - verification]
Question 6: Triangle with sides 6 cm, 8 cm, 10 cm. Is it right-angled?
[4 marks marks]
 For a right-angled triangle, Pythagorean theorem states:
 (Longest side)² = (Other side)² + (Other side)²
 Check: 10² = 6² + 8² [1 mark - setting up check]
 100 = 36 + 64
 100 = 100 ✓ [2 marks - calculation]
 Yes, the triangle is right-angled.
 ✓ Reason: The Pythagorean theorem is satisfied. [1 mark - conclusion and reason]
Question 7: Simplify the ratio 24:36:60
[4 marks marks]
 Find the HCF (Highest Common Factor) of 24, 36, and 60
 24 = 2³ × 3 [1 mark - prime factorisation]
 36 = 2² × 3²
 60 = 2² × 3 × 5
 HCF = 2² × 3 = 12 [1 mark - finding HCF]
 24:36:60 = 24÷12 : 36÷12 : 60÷12 [1 mark - dividing by HCF]
 = 2:3:5 [1 mark - final answer]
Question 8: Machine gives 15% loss. Cost price Sh 2,000. Find selling price.
[4 marks marks]
 Cost Price (CP) = Sh 2,000 [1 mark]
 Loss = 15% of CP
 Loss = 15% × 2,000 [1 mark - calculating loss]
 = 0.15 × 2,000
 = Sh 300
 Selling Price = CP − Loss [1 mark - using formula]
 = 2,000 − 300
 = Sh 1,700 [1 mark - final answer]
Question 9: Average of 6, 8, 10, x and 14 is 10. Find x.
[4 marks marks]
 Average = Sum of values / Number of values [1 mark - formula]
 10 = (6 + 8 + 10 + x + 14) / 5
 10 = (38 + x) / 5 [1 mark - summing known values]
 10 × 5 = 38 + x [1 mark - multiplying both sides by 5]
 50 = 38 + x
 x = 50 − 38
 x = 12 [1 mark - solution]
 ✓ Check: (6 + 8 + 10 + 12 + 14) / 5 = 50 / 5 = 10 ✓
Question 10: Class has 12 boys and 18 girls. Probability of selecting a boy.
[4 marks marks]
 Total students = 12 + 18 = 30 [1 mark - total]
 Number of boys = 12 [1 mark]
 Probability = Favourable outcomes / Total outcomes
 P(boy) = 12/30 [1 mark - setting up probability]
 = 2/5 or 0.4 or 40% [1 mark - simplifying]
SECTION B: 60 MARKS
Students should answer any 5 questions from this section
Question 11: Simultaneous Equations and Linear Expression
[6 marks marks]
 (a) Solve: 2x + y = 11 and x − y = 1
 From the second equation: x − y = 1
 x=y+1 [1 mark - rearranging]
 Substitute into first equation:
 2(y + 1) + y = 11 [1 mark - substituting]
 2y + 2 + y = 11
 3y + 2 = 11 [1 mark - simplifying]
 3y = 9
 y=3 [1 mark - solving for y]
 x=y+1=3+1=4 [1 mark - solving for x]
 ✓ Verification: 2(4) + 3 = 11 ✓ and 4 − 3 = 1 ✓
 (b) Find the value of 3x − 2y
 3x − 2y = 3(4) − 2(3) [0.5 marks - substituting values]
 = 12 − 6
 =6 [0.5 marks - final answer]
Question 12: Triangle on Cartesian Plane
[6 marks marks]
 (a) Plot the triangle on a Cartesian plane
 Triangle PQR with P(1,2), Q(5,2), and R(5,6) plotted correctly
 ✓ Diagram showing correct coordinates and triangle shape (2 marks)
 (b) Find the area of triangle PQR
 From coordinates: P(1,2), Q(5,2), R(5,6)
 Base PQ is horizontal from (1,2) to (5,2)
 Length of base = 5 − 1 = 4 units [1 mark]
 Height = perpendicular distance from R to PQ
 Height = 6 − 2 = 4 units [1 mark]
 Area = 1/2 × base × height [1 mark - formula]
 = 1/2 × 4 × 4
 = 1/2 × 16
 = 8 square units [1 mark - final answer]
Question 13: Rectangular Field - Perimeter and Area
[6 marks marks]
 (a) Find the perimeter
 Length (L) = 60 m, Width (W) = 35 m
 Perimeter = 2(L + W) [1 mark - formula]
 = 2(60 + 35)
 = 2(95)
 = 190 m [1 mark - final answer]
 (b) Find the area in m² and hectares
 Area = L × W [1 mark - formula]
 = 60 × 35
 = 2,100 m² [1 mark - in square meters]
 Converting to hectares:
 1 hectare = 10,000 m² [1 mark - conversion factor]
 Area = 2,100 ÷ 10,000
 = 0.21 hectares [1 mark - in hectares]
Question 14: Right-angled Triangle - Area and Hypotenuse
[6 marks marks]
 (a) Find the area
 Base = 12 cm, Height = 5 cm
 Area = 1/2 × base × height [1 mark - formula]
 = 1/2 × 12 × 5
 =6×5
 = 30 cm² [1 mark - final answer]
 (b) Find the length of the hypotenuse
 Using Pythagorean theorem: c² = a² + b² [1 mark - formula]
 c² = 12² + 5²
 c² = 144 + 25 [1 mark - squaring]
 c² = 169 [1 mark - adding]
 c = √169
 c = 13 cm [1 mark - final answer]
Question 15: Circular Garden - Circumference and Area
[6 marks marks]
 (a) Find the circumference
 Radius (r) = 7 m
 Circumference = 2πr [1 mark - formula]
 = 2 × 22/7 × 7
 = 2 × 22 × (7/7)
 = 2 × 22
 = 44 m [1 mark - final answer]
 (b) Find the area (Use π = 22/7)
 Area = πr² [1 mark - formula]
 = 22/7 × 7²
 = 22/7 × 49 [1 mark - squaring radius]
 = (22 × 49) / 7
 = 22 × (49/7) [1 mark - simplifying]
 = 22 × 7
 = 154 m² [1 mark - final answer]
Question 16: Map Scale and Speed Calculation
[6 marks marks]
 (a) Find the actual distance between the towns
 Map scale: 1 cm represents 5 km
 Distance on map = 8.4 cm
 Actual distance = 8.4 × 5 [1 mark - using scale]
 = 42 km [1 mark - calculation]
 ✓ Final answer: 42 km (3 marks total for part a)
 (b) Time taken at 60 km/h
 Time = Distance / Speed [1 mark - formula]
 = 42 / 60
 = 0.7 hours [1 mark - calculation]
 Converting to minutes: 0.7 × 60 = 42 minutes
 ✓ Final answer: 0.7 hours or 42 minutes (3 marks total for part b)
Question 17: Probability with Colored Balls
[6 marks marks]
 (a) Probability of picking a blue ball
 Total balls = 5 + 3 + 2 = 10 balls [1 mark - counting total]
 Blue balls = 3
 P(blue) = 3/10 [1 mark - probability]
 (b) Probability of picking a red or green ball
 Red balls = 5, Green balls = 2
 Red or green = 5 + 2 = 7 balls [1 mark - counting favorable outcomes]
 P(red or green) = 7/10 [2 marks - probability and answer]
 ✓ Alternative: P(red or green) = 1 − P(blue) = 1 − 3/10 = 7/10
Question 18: Measures of Central Tendency
[6 marks marks]
 Data: 2, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6, 6, 6, 7
 (a) Find the mode
 Mode = most frequently occurring value
 Value 6 appears 3 times (more than any other)
 ✓ Mode = 6 (1 mark)
 (b) Find the median
 Data in order: 2, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6, 6, 6, 7
 Number of values = 9 (odd number) [1 mark]
 Median position = (9 + 1) / 2 = 5th value [1 mark]
 Median = 5 [counting]
 ✓ Median = 5 (2 marks total)
 (c) Find the mean
 Mean = Sum of values / Number of values [1 mark - formula]
 Sum = 2 + 3 + 4 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 6 + 6 + 7
 = 43 [1 mark - calculating sum]
 Mean = 43 / 9
 = 4.78 (to 2 d.p.) or 4⁷/₉ (as fraction)
 ✓ Mean = 4.78 or 43/9 (3 marks total for part c)
